name: Survey
what: A licensed surveyor's drawing and certification of the land's boundaries, improvements, easements and encroachments.

fields.label: Standard
fields.definition: The standard the survey was made to, such as a 2026 ALTA/NSPS Land Title Survey.
fields.authority: ALTA/NSPS Minimum Standard Detail Requirements (2026), effective February 23, 2026

fields.label: Table A items
fields.definition: The optional Table A items the request asked for and the survey includes.
fields.authority: ALTA/NSPS Minimum Standard Detail Requirements (2026), Table A

fields.label: Certified to
fields.definition: The parties named in the surveyor's certification, typically the buyer, the lender and the title insurer.
fields.authority: ALTA/NSPS Minimum Standard Detail Requirements (2026), certification

fields.label: Title evidence used
fields.definition: The title commitment, by number and effective date, whose recorded matters the survey shows or addresses.

fields.label: Date of fieldwork
fields.definition: The date the surveyor last worked on the ground; it shows how current the survey is.

fields.label: Encroachments and conflicts
fields.definition: Encroachments, protrusions, overlaps and boundary conflicts the survey shows, the matters the area-and-boundary exception otherwise leaves uninsured.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-7, Schedule B, item 2

fields.label: Evidence of possession
fields.definition: Evidence of possession or use found along the perimeter, and any statements owners or occupants made about the boundary.

fields.label: Flood zone
fields.definition: The FEMA flood zone and map panel for the land, with the map's effective date.

fields.label: Surveyor
fields.definition: The licensed surveyor who signed and sealed the survey, and the firm.
